mapper.select: SELECT a.user_code AS id,a.name AS username, IF ( IFNULL(a.post_code, '' ) = '', 'https://qny.guyijk.com/xiaochengxu/toxiangnan.png', a.post_code) AS avatar FROM `yh_user_reginfo` AS a LEFT JOIN `yh_wx_user` AS b ON a.user_code=b.user_id WHERE a.user_code IN ( SELECT user_code FROM `yh_user_make_card` WHERE doctor=(SELECT id FROM `yh_user_admin_info` WHERE user_code=#{usercode} LIMIT 1) )

SELECT a.user_code AS id,a.name AS username, IF ( IFNULL(a.post_code, '' ) = '', 'https://qny.guyijk.com/xiaochengxu/toxiangnan.png', a.post_code) AS avatar FROM `yh_user_reginfo` AS a WHERE a.user_code=#{usercode} limit 1

SELECT regin.`name` AS username,enro.user_code AS id ,regin.post_code AS avatar FROM yh_user_enrolinfo enro LEFT JOIN yh_user_reginfo regin ON enro.user_code=regin.user_code LEFT JOIN yh_user_make_card card ON enro.user_code=card.User_Code LEFT JOIN `yh_wx_user` AS wx ON wx.user_id=enro.user_code WHERE card.doctor= (SELECT id FROM yh_user_admin_info WHERE user_code =#{usercode})
AND enro.Flag_Dgroup LIKE CONCAT('%',#{groupid},'%') GROUP BY enro.E_User_Id
